student_learning_goal: I can name coins up to 50¢ and their values.

header.student_learning_goal_banner: I can name coins up to 50¢ and their values.
header.character_watermark: Penny the Penguin Shopkeeper in the top-right with apron and coin pouch. Small (~1.5in). References blueprint.recurring_characters.

parts.student_instructions: Look at 4 coins. Write the name under each.
parts.visual_layout: Four coin icons in a row with name lines under each.

image_placeholders.description: A Grade 1 coin identification row for money worksheet, B&W line art. 4 coin icons: nickel, dime, quarter, 50¢. Each with a name line below.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: WS01_P1_NAMES at Part 1: keywords name the coin icons identification task.

parts.student_instructions: Draw a line from each coin to its value.
parts.visual_layout: Four coins on the left and four values (5¢, 10¢, 25¢, 50¢) on the right.

image_placeholders.description: A Grade 1 coin-value match for money worksheet, B&W line art. Left column: 4 coins. Right column: 4 values (5¢, 10¢, 25¢, 50¢).
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: WS01_P2_MATCH at Part 2: keywords name the coins values match task.

parts.student_instructions: For 3 pairs, circle the coin worth MORE.
parts.visual_layout: Three pair boxes each with two coins side by side.

image_placeholders.description: A Grade 1 coin-comparison layout for money worksheet, B&W line art. 3 pairs: nickel vs dime, dime vs quarter, quarter vs 50¢. Each in a pair box.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: WS01_P3_MORE at Part 3: keywords name the pair circle more task.

early_finisher_prompt: If you finish, draw the coin you'd pick to buy a 25¢ apple.
teacher_notes: Lesson 1 consolidation. Diagnostic — check coin naming and matching.
